authority: machine contract for forge-p0; spec.md Validation Plan is the human-readable view, this JSON is the machine grammar consumed by devflow.cjs validate

assertions.title: PR create 声明 closes 后,pr show 展示 closes 目标
assertions.behavior: PR create 声明 closes 后,pr show 展示 closes 目标

assertions.title: closes 目标 Issue 在 PR 合并成功后变为 closed
assertions.behavior: closes 目标 Issue 在 PR 合并成功后变为 closed
assertions.evidence: `git forge issue show <n>` 输出 closed;merge exit 0

assertions.title: 目标 Issue 已 closed 时合并仍成功且不写第二个 close 事件
assertions.behavior: 目标 Issue 已 closed 时合并仍成功且不写第二个 close 事件
assertions.evidence: merge exit 0;issue show 仍 closed(事件链长度不变,fold 值不变)

assertions.title: 合并失败时(门未过/冲突)目标 Issue 保持 open
assertions.behavior: 合并失败时(门未过/冲突)目标 Issue 保持 open
assertions.evidence: 构造 merge 失败后 `issue show` 仍 open;merge exit 非零

assertions.title: abandon 后 pr show 展示 abandoned 与 reason
assertions.behavior: abandon 后 pr show 展示 abandoned 与 reason

assertions.title: abandon 后 merge 拒绝、退出非零、错误消息命名 reason
assertions.behavior: abandon 后 merge 拒绝、退出非零、错误消息命名 reason
assertions.evidence: `git forge pr merge <n>` exit 非零,stderr 含 reason

assertions.title: abandon 后 review 拒绝
assertions.evidence: `git forge pr review <n> --approve` exit 非零

assertions.title: abandon 后 ci run 拒绝且不追加 ci.check
assertions.behavior: abandon 后 ci run 拒绝且不追加 ci.check
assertions.evidence: `git forge ci run <n>` exit 非零;`pr show` 的 CI 状态不变(仍为 create 时的 pending)

assertions.title: 二次 abandon 拒绝,不写第二个 abandoned 事件
assertions.behavior: 二次 abandon 拒绝,不写第二个 abandoned 事件
assertions.evidence: 第二次 `pr abandon` exit 非零;`pr show` 展示同一(首个)reason

assertions.title: 已 merge 的 PR 拒绝 abandon
assertions.behavior: 已 merge 的 PR 拒绝 abandon
assertions.evidence: merge 成功后 `pr abandon` exit 非零
